title: Creamy Borlotti Bean Pasta
description: A comforting, gluten-free pasta dish made with borlotti beans, wholesome cream, and earthy herbs.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the gluten-free pasta according to package instructions.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the borlotti beans, italian herbs, salt, and pepper. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the wholesome cream. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the saucepan with the borlotti bean mixture.
Toss the pasta in the creamy sauce until well coated.
Serve hot, garnished with additional italian herbs if desired.
